description.text: One of the two BW3 expansions released together on 16 September 2011, in which Pokémon-EX made their debut: cards with overwhelming HP and damage, unrelated to the older Pokémon ex. Its headline is Mewtwo-EX, the Pokémon that had held the title of strongest since Red and Green, joined by Shaymin-EX and Kyogre-EX. Both packs are set in Castelia City, the heart of Unova, and from here Pokémon from every region returned to the BW series. Its Ultra Rares are shiny Zoroark and Hydreigon. The cards are numbered to 52. In English most of them came out in Next Destinies in February 2012, and Kyogre-EX in Dark Explorers in May 2012.
